question: roads with sidewalk subclass
sql: SELECT id, names."primary" AS name, subclass FROM lisbon_roads WHERE subclass = 'sidewalk'

question: show me road segments near (38.72, -9.14)
sql: SELECT id, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geom FROM lisbon_roads WHERE ST_DWithin_Spheroid(geometry, ST_Point(-9.14, 38.72), 500)

question: length of tertiary roads in km
sql: SELECT id, ROUND(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) / 1000, 2) AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'tertiary'

question: residential roads with max speed over 50 km/h
sql: SELECT id, names."primary" AS name, speed_limits[1].max_speed.value AS max_speed FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' AND speed_limits[1].max_speed.value > 50

question: get start point of each secondary road as WKT
sql: SELECT id, ST_AsText(ST_StartPoint(geometry)) AS start_point FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'secondary'

question: coordinates of road centroids rounded to 4 decimals
sql: SELECT id, ROUND(ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry)), 4) AS lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)), 4) AS lat FROM lisbon_roads LIMIT 10
